en: A vintage black‑and‑white winter scene showing three deer feeding in the snow around a simple wooden feeder covered with evergreen branches beneath a large tree. Behind them stands a long half‑timbered building with many paned windows and decorative panels along the base. Trees without leaves and a lamppost are visible. Printed red text appears on the right margin of the card.
